data.name: Aaban
data.gender_notes: Aaban is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Waters; name of the angel of waters (also the 8th month of the Persian calendar)
data.long_meaning: From Persian Ābān (آبان), the name of the eighth month of the Persian (Solar Hijri) calendar and of the Zoroastrian guardian of waters, from āb (آب) 'water'. Used as a given name in Persian and Urdu-speaking Muslim communities. Aaban therefore means “Waters; name of the angel of waters (also the 8th month of the Persian calendar)”. Persian calendar month name and Zoroastrian angel of waters; used as a personal name in Persian/Urdu.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaban expresses “Angel of clouds, Name of an Islamic month”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Persian Ābān (آبان), the name of the eighth month of the Persian (Solar Hijri) calendar and of the Zoroastrian guardian of waters, from āb (آب) 'water'. Used as a given name in Persian and Urdu-speaking Muslim communities.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaban total 10, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

faq.q: What is the connection between Aaban and water?
faq.a: Aaban comes from Persian āb (آب) 'water'. Ābān is the name of the Zoroastrian guardian of waters and of the eighth month of the Persian calendar, which is why the name is associated with water.

faq.q: What does the name Aaban mean?
faq.a: Aaban means “Waters; name of the angel of waters (also the 8th month of the Persian calendar)”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aaban come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aaban?
faq.a: The root of Aaban is Persian Ābān (آبان), from āb (آب) 'water'.

faq.q: How is Aaban written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aaban is written آبان in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aaban a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aaban is used as a male name.

faq.q: Does Aaban appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aaban is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aaban verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Waters; name of the angel of waters (also the 8th month of the Persian calendar)” is established by Persian calendar month name and Zoroastrian angel of waters; used as a personal name in Persian/Urdu..
